steps.title: Three versions, one result
steps.text: The page loads all three versions: `simple.js`, `promise-a+.js` and `index.js`. The numbers come from the class version, `ForgePromise`. It resolves with `1`; the first `then` callback records `1` and returns `2`; the second records `2` and writes the list into the page.
steps.textZh: 页面加载了全部三个版本：`simple.js`、`promise-a+.js` 和 `index.js`。页面上的数字来自基于 class 的版本 `ForgePromise`：它以 `1` 完成；第一个 `then` 回调记下 `1` 并返回 `2`；第二个回调记下 `2`，再把列表写进页面。

steps.title: simple.js: a state and a queue
steps.text: `MyPromise` settles once and runs the waiting callbacks later, as microtasks, never in the middle of your code: the line logged after both `then` calls comes first. But `then` returns the same promise, so the second callback gets `1` again instead of the first callback's result. It cannot chain.
steps.textZh: `MyPromise` 只结算一次，并且总是稍后作为微任务运行等待中的回调，绝不会插进正在运行的代码中间：在两次 `then` 之后打印的那一行反而先出现。但它的 `then` 返回的是同一个 Promise，所以第二个回调拿到的又是 `1`，而不是第一个回调的结果。它还不能链式调用。

action.run: const p = new MyPromise((resolve) => resolve(1)); console.log('state:', p.state); const same = p.then((value) => console.log('first callback got', value)); same.then((value) => console.log('second callback got', value)); console.log('then() returned the same promise:', same === p)

steps.actionLabel: Chain two then calls on MyPromise
steps.actionLabelZh: 在 MyPromise 上连用两次 then
expectConsole: then() returned the same promise: true

steps.title: promise-a+.js: then makes a new promise
steps.text: In `PromiseA`, `then` returns a new promise. When a callback returns another promise, or any object with a `then` method, the new promise takes on its result. Here the callback returns a plain object whose `then` hands over `value + 1`, so the next callback gets `2`.
steps.textZh: 在 `PromiseA` 里，`then` 会返回一个新的 Promise。如果回调返回了另一个 Promise，或者任何带 `then` 方法的对象，新的 Promise 就会接管它的结果。这里的回调返回一个普通对象，它的 `then` 交出 `value + 1`，所以下一个回调拿到 `2`。

action.run: const p = new PromiseA((resolve) => resolve(1)); const next = p.then((value) => ({ then: (resolve) => resolve(value + 1) })); console.log('then() returned a new promise:', next !== p); next.then((value) => console.log('the next callback got', value))

steps.actionLabel: Return an object with a then method
steps.actionLabelZh: 在回调里返回带 then 方法的对象
expectConsole: then() returned a new promise: true

steps.title: No promise can resolve to itself
steps.titleZh: Promise 不能解析成它自己
steps.text: If a callback returns the very promise that its `then` created, that promise would wait for itself forever. The resolution procedure rejects it with a `TypeError` instead.
steps.textZh: 如果回调返回的正是它所在的 `then` 创建的那个 Promise，这个 Promise 就会永远等着自己。解析过程会改为用一个 `TypeError` 拒绝它。

action.run: const loop = new PromiseA((resolve) => resolve()).then(() => loop); loop.catch((reason) => console.log('rejected with', reason))

steps.actionLabel: Return the promise from its own then
steps.actionLabelZh: 让 then 回调返回它自己创建的 Promise
expectConsole: rejected with TypeError: A promise cannot resolve to itself

steps.title: index.js: race and all
steps.text: The class version adds helpers. Here both get the same two values: a promise that settles with `'slow'` after 100 ms, and the plain value `'fast'`. `race` settles with whichever settles first, `'fast'`. `all` waits for both and keeps their order, so `'slow'` still comes first.
steps.textZh: 基于 class 的版本加入了几个辅助方法。这里两者拿到同样的两个值：一个 100 毫秒后以 `'slow'` 完成的 Promise，和普通值 `'fast'`。`race` 跟随最先结算的那个，也就是 `'fast'`。`all` 等两者都完成，并保持原来的顺序，所以 `'slow'` 仍排在前面。

action.run: const slow = new ForgePromise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve('slow'), 100)); ForgePromise.race([slow, 'fast']).then((value) => console.log('race:', value)); ForgePromise.all([slow, 'fast']).then((list) => console.log('all:', list))

steps.actionLabel: Race and all on the same values
steps.actionLabelZh: 对同样的值分别用 race 和 all

steps.title: finally runs either way
steps.titleZh: finally 成功失败都会运行
steps.text: `finally` runs its callback whether the promise was fulfilled or rejected, then passes the original result on. This promise is rejected with `boom`: the `finally` callback runs, and the `catch` after it still gets `boom`.
steps.textZh: 无论 Promise 成功还是失败，`finally` 都会运行它的回调，然后把原来的结果原样传下去。这个 Promise 以 `boom` 被拒绝：`finally` 的回调照常运行，后面的 `catch` 拿到的仍然是 `boom`。

action.run: ForgePromise.reject(new Error('boom')).finally(() => console.log('finally callback ran')).catch((error) => console.log('catch got', error.message))
